stepAnswer: opens ion channels and generates action potential
stepExplanation: Neurotransmitters bind to specific receptors on the postsynaptic membrane, causing **ion channels to open**. If excitatory, sodium ions enter and cause depolarization, potentially generating a new action potential. The signal is thus transmitted chemically across the synapse.
